_about: L. Susan Stebbing (1885-1943), English analytic philosopher, first woman to hold a philosophy chair in Britain. Raw IA OCR: Pragmatism and French Voluntarism (Cambridge, Girton College Studies, 1914). Held: A Modern Introduction to Logic; the only scan is a Crowell, New York, printing with no year on its title page, and a printing after 1930 cannot be ruled out. US public domain. No uids minted.
